name: Companion
description: Sending, the keepalive schedule, and the inbox the host drains - all through the companion APK.

settings.label: Collect incoming calls
settings.help: Missed and answered. The app sees the phone state rather than the call log, so a rejected call is reported as missed - on an unattended unit the actionable fact is the same.

settings.label: Include message bodies
settings.help: Turn off to relay only sender and time. The host then knows a message arrived without the content ever leaving the phone.

settings.label: Spool cap
settings.help: Oldest events are dropped past this. Bounds disk use if the host stops draining; the drop is counted and exported.

settings.label: Send a keepalive
settings.help: Operators reclaim a SIM that has not been used, and a racked unit only ever receives. Off by default because it spends money on a SIM whose terms only you know.

settings.label: Keepalive destination
settings.help: A number, or self to text each SIM's own number. self resolves only if the operator wrote the number onto the SIM; when it did not, the attempt is reported as no_target rather than silently skipped.

settings.label: Keepalive interval
settings.help: 30 days. Operators that expire an idle SIM give 90 to 180, so this leaves two missed runs of headroom at twelve messages a year. Any successful send counts as activity, so a SIM the host already used sends nothing extra.

settings.label: Which SIMs to keep alive
settings.help: An operator only sees its own SIM, so on a dual-SIM unit all is the setting that keeps both. default narrows to the subscription Android would send from.

settings.label: Keepalive text
settings.help: Plain ASCII keeps it one GSM-7 part and one charge; a single Cyrillic character would switch the whole message to UCS-2.

settings.label: Balance USSD code
settings.help: Asked on every SIM on a schedule. Every operator has its own code, and an empty value turns the checks off entirely. Beeline answers *102#.

settings.label: Balance check interval
settings.help: Daily. A prepaid SIM does not empty in an hour, and each check is a network round trip on a device whose whole point is to be left alone.

actions.label: Check the app can be reached and can send
Read the balance on every SIM
